system.description:
Range 60ft; one door, lock, chest, shackle or similar fastening. It opens instantly, ending Hold Portal on it. A permanently sealed (Wizard-Locked) door opens but the spell is suppressed for 10 minutes. Cast reversed (Lock), a closed fastening is locked for 1 hour per level; Knock or a creature with Str 18+ breaks it.

Reversible: may be cast as its opposite with the same slot.

Classes: Wizard, Sorcerer
